Allianz Research: englischsprachiger Sec: Allianz Research: English-language Sector Atlas dated 7 September 2026, 52 pages and 17 sectors. The methodology on page 48 assesses sector non-payment risk in 70 countries using demand, profitability, liquidity and business environment, combining internal data, external indicators and expert judgment. Its four levels are Low, Medium, Sensitive and High. In this atlas: IT Services Low (p. 22), Electronics Medium (p. 16), Machinery and Equipment Medium (p. 24) and Telecom Medium (p. 36). These are sector assessments, not individual credit ratings. Topics include AI-driven changes to software and services models, inference costs, demand for security and controlled industry solutions, electronics margin and supply-chain risks, and AI data-center connectivity and satellite competition in telecom. Useful for preparing customer, market and receivables risk reviews. The supplied PDF and relevant specialist chapters were reviewed on 13 October 2026; methodology and the electronics rating were also visually checked. Forecasts and ratings refer to the document date. The German online summary is dated 11 September 2026.
